newsitem.title: UK: WlmCook says sees Triplex bid withdrawals.
newsitem.headline: WlmCook says sees Triplex bid withdrawals.

text.p: William Cook Plc, fighting off a takeover offer by rival metal engineering group Triplex Lloyd Plc, said on Monday that notices of withdrawal of Triplex Lloyd's bid in respect of 5.44 percent of its shares had been lodged with Triplex's agent.

"After taking this into account, the level of acceptances announced by Triplex Lloyd at December 31 1996 would be reduced to a mere 0.39 percent of William Cook's share capital," Cook said in a statement.
The deadline for shareholders to accept Triplex Lloyd's bid has been extended to 1500 GMT tomorrow, January 14.
"I am glad shareholdes are appreciating our strong arguments on value and prospects and how Triplex Lloyd's offer is derisory," William Cook chairman Andrew Cook was quoted as saying in a statement.
Cook has argued fiercely that Triplex's cash and shares bid, which values Cook at just over 300 pence per share, has misjudged his company's value.
"They should accept defeat, withdraw their bid and leave us to deliver full value to our shareholders," Cook added.
